children.html: Roast beef tenderloin in sour cream sauce - Svíčková

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 4 lbs. beef tenderloin
  • • 3 slices bacon
  • • 1/2 cup vegetable oil
  • • 2 cups sliced soup greens (carrots, parsnips, celery root)
  • • 1 medium onion, sliced
  • • few grains allspice, whole black pepper, thyme, bay leaves, nutmeg
  • • 2 tablespoons flour
  • • 1 cup beef stock
  • • juice of one lemon
  • • 1.1/2 cups sour cream
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Tenderloin must be aged and all the fat trimmed off. Cut small slits along the grain of the meat and stuff them with thin strips of bacon. Salt and pepper the meat and set aside.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: In a large frying pan combine the oil, half of the sliced soup greens and the onion; place the roast on top and brown on all sides.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: In the meantime preheat the oven to 350F. Transfer the roast and the vegetables into a roasting pan, add the remaining

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: vegetables and spices. Roast 40-45 minutes, basting with beef stock and juices from the pan. Remove the roast, keep it warm. Pour the pan drippings into a large stewpan, skim the fat, set pan over medium heat and deglaze, using stock or water. Add the flour, simmer five minutes. Place the roast in the sauce, add the lemon juice and simmer until the meat becomes tender on the outside (20 minutes).

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Strain the sauce, discard the spices, mash the vegetables and mix them into the sauce. Blend in the sour cream and simmer for a few minutes. The sauce should be medium thick.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Slice the roast, pour some sauce over it and serve the remainder in a sauce dish.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: It is important that you make enough sauce, adding beef stock and sour cream. Taste it and add

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: salt, pepper, lemon juice – if needed. The taste should be mildly piquant. The typical accompaniment is crouton or yeast dumplings, or noodles.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Alternative – Lard the tenderloin, grease a roasting pan with oil, cover the bottom of the pan with the vegetables, lay the roast on top, add more vegetables, spices and lemon juice. Add the remaining oil, cover and marinate overnight. Next day prepare the roast as indicated above.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: ▷ If planning to prepare a larger quantity, for example a whole tenderloin, increase all ingredients accordingly. Instead of browning the roast by frying, roast it on all sides in a hot oven (475F), then lower the temperature to 350F and proceed as shown above.

children.html: Beef tenderloin slices (shortcut for "svíčková") - Řezy ze svíčkové

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 4 lbs. beef tenderloin
  • • 3 slices bacon
  • • 4 tablespoons vegetable oil
  • • 4 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 medium size onion, chopped
  • • 2 pickled cucumbers (sour), sliced
  • • 2 canned fillets of anchovies, chopped
  • • 3 teaspoons capers
  • • chopped parsley, thyme, marjoram, lemon rind
  • • 1-1/2 cups sour cream
  • • 2 tablespoons flour
  • • 1-1/2 cups chicken or beef stock, or water
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 2 lbs. ground round
  • • 1 whole egg
  • • 2 hard baked rolls
  • • 2 slices bacon
  • • salt, pepper, marjoram
  • • 1 medium size onion
  • • 3/4 cup water
  • • 3/4 cup bread crumbs
  • • 1/2 cup oil for frying

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Cut the tenderloin into 1" thick slices. Pound each slice with the palm of your hand and lard with half slice bacon each. Salt and pepper them lightly and fry in hot oil about 2-1/2 minutes on each side. Place them in a casserole, keep them warm.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: In a saucepan combine melted butter, onion, pickles, anchovies, parsley, capers, lemon rind, marjoram and thyme and brown all. Add flour, brown a little more. Add stock or water, sour cream. Simmer for five minutes, strain and pour over the meat slices. Simmer until heated through.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
A paragraph or line of text.
The header of a section of text or other blocks.
A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Soak the rolls in water, squeeze off excess liquid, shred them. Blend them with the ground meat, egg, chopped onion, diced bacon, salt, pepper and marjoram.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Form 12 hamburgers, coat them with bread crumbs and fry on both sides.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Instead of frying, they can be roasted in the oven, basting them with hot oil, their own juices, chicken or beef stock, or water.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serve with mashed potatoes and salad. Or serve cold with dark bread, potato salad, or pickles.

children.html: Veal chops with caraway seeds - Teleci žebirka na kminë

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 6 veal chops
  • • 1/2 cup flour
  • • 1/2 cup vegetable oil
  • • 2 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 cup chicken stock
  • • 1 small onion
  • • 1 teaspoon caraway seeds
  • • salt

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Pound the veal chops lightly-they should not be more than 1/2" thick. Make a few short cuts on the edges to prevent curling, salt them on both sides, and dust with flour on one side. Brown chops in hot oil on both sides, floured side first. In a skillet combine the butter and finely chopped onion and set over medium heat.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: When the onion becomes translucent add the caraway seeds, some of the chicken stock and the veal chops and simmer about 30 minutes or until the chops are tender.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Remove the veal chops. Bring the liquid to boil, blend in flour and remaining stock, and boil until the sauce thickens (about 5 minutes). Strain the sauce over the veal chops, simmer 5 minutes. Serve with noodles, rice, salad.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
The header of a section of text or other blocks.

children.html:
• • 6 veal chops
  • • 1/2 cup flour
  • • 2 eggs
  • • 1/3 cup milk
  • • 1 cup bread crumbs
  • • 1 cup vegetable oil
  • • salt

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Pound the veal chops. Make a few short cuts on the edges to prevent curling, salt them on both sides. Dip each in milk, dredge in flour shaking off excess, then dip in beaten eggs and coat with bread crumbs.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Fry in hot oil in a covered pan for 5 minutes, turn them and finish frying uncovered. Drain on paper towel. Serve with potato salad, mashed potatoes, green vegetables, salad.

children.html: Leg of lamb in wine sauce - Skopová kýta dušená

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 3-4 lbs. lamb leg, boned, skinned (4-5 lbs. with bone)
  • • 1/3 cup vegetable oil
  • • 5 slices bacon
  • • 1/2 teaspoon each of ginger and ground nutmeg
  • • salt and pepper
  • • 1 parsnip, 3 carrots, 1 celery root,
  • • 1 medium onion
  • • 3 bay leaves, whole allspice, whole black pepper
  • • 3 tablespoons flour
  • • juice of 1 lemon
  • • 1/4 cup cranberry juice, unsweetened
  • • 1 cup dry red wine
  • • 1-2 cups chicken stock

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Slice thinly parsnip, carrots, celery root and onion.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Trim off excess fat from the meat, lard it with bacon (= make small slits in roast and push a strip of bacon into each slit).

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Mix salt, pepper, ginger, nutmeg. Rub over lamb.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Heat the oil in a large stewpot, add the sliced vegetables, cook five minutes.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Place the lamb in the pot, brown it lightly, sprinkle with the remaining spices.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Cover and simmer 1 hour, gradually adding chicken stock.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Spoon fat from the juices, stir in flour and cook until lightly browned.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Blend in lemon juice, cranberry juice, wine, chicken stock.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Return lamb to the mixture, cover and simmer until tender for about 1 hour.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Place lamb on a warm serving platter, garnish with mint, cranberries, snipped parsley, chestnuts.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Strain the sauce, heat thoroughly, serve in a saucedish.

children.html: up. Continue roasting for 1-1/2 hours. While roasting, prick the skin with a fork over the fatty areas to release fat. (Just the skin, not the meat. children.html: Duckling with Madeira wine - Kachna na vině

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 duckling, 5-6 lbs.
  • • 5 slices ham, cut in stripes
  • • 8 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 cup Madeira wine
  • • 1 cup chicken stock
  • • 3 tablespoons flour
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rinse duckling, pat dry. Sprinkle with salt and pepper inside and out. Melt butter in a roasting pan, add ham and duckling. Brown it quickly on both sides under the broiler. Lower oven temperature to 350F. Pour Madeira wine over duckling. Add some of the chicken stock, salt and pepper, and cover with buttered waxpaper. Roast 1 to 1-1/2 hours, occasionally adding the remaining chicken stock.

children.html: Salmon trout with dill sauce - Pstruh s koprovou omáčkou

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 6 trouts, 4 lbs., cleaned, with heads and tails left on
  • • 1/2 bottle white wine
  • • 1.1/2 quarts water
  • • 1 medium onion, quartered
  • • juice of one lemon
  • • 10 black peppercorns
  • • 2 bay leaves
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • parsley, finely chopped
  • • salt

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 3 tablespoons butter and 4 tablespoons flour
  • • 2 tablespoons finely chopped dill
  • • 1 small onion, finely chopped
  • • parsley, finely chopped
  • • 2 cups fish broth
  • • 1 tablespoon vinegar
  • • 1 teaspoon sugar
  • • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • • salt

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html:
Heat the wine, water, onion, lemon juice, bay leaves and peppercorns. Simmer 10 minutes. Add the trouts and simmer gently for 15 minutes, without boiling.

Drain fish, arrange on a heated serving platter, keep it warm. Strain the broth from the fish, reserve 2 cups for dill sauce. Meanwhile, prepare the sauce. Melt butter in a saucepan, blend in flour, stir and cook until golden. Add onion, parsley, fish broth, vinegar, sugar, salt. Cook, uncovered, until sauce thickens. Strain. Blend in the cream and chopped dill. Heat through, do not boil. Pour hot butter over trouts, garnish with parsley. Hand sauce separately.

children.html: Fresh yeast is sold in most American supermarkets packed in 2 oz. cubes and dated for freshness (Fleischmann's, Red Star). Store it in the refrigerator but remove it at least 1 hour prior to using.

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• - All ingredients as well as the pastry board or the mixing bowl must be at room temperature. Milk and butter must be lukewarm, not hot. It would inactivate the yeast. When the dough is set aside to rise it must be in a warm and draft free place. The dough should be dusted with a little flour and covered with cloth napkin.
  • - While kneading the dough, the melted butter and the salt should not touch directly the leavening, as this would retard fermentation. Therefore mix the salt with the flour and add the butter in the end when all ingredients are already mixed with the leavening.
  • - The dough for larger pieces is thicker than for small size pastries. If you find it difficult to use a wooden spoon, you can knead with hands after all ingredients are well mixed. The dough must be kneaded thoroughly, until it is smooth, feels dry, and no longer sticks to the bowl, spoon and hands.
  • - The quantities of ingredients indicated are to be followed exactly. So is the sequence of additions.

• • 2 cups flour
  • • 1/3 cup sugar mixed with 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar
  • • 1 stick butter
  • • 2 tablespoons milk
  • • grated rind of 1 lemon
  • • red raspberry or red currant preserve

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: On a floured pastry board knead all ingredients into a ball using the palms of your hands, not the fingers. The dough will be smooth and will not crumble. You can let it rest for a few hours, overnight or more. You can use it right away also.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: With a roller pin roll the dough out as thin as possible. (1/8"). Cut it into 1-1/4" round cakes, using a cookie cutter or a glass. Separate half of the round cakes and cut out a small round hole in the center, the size of a thimble. Use a cookie cutter or a thimble. Place the round cakes on a clean, dry cookie sheet and bake at 350F for 15 minutes, or until they are pink/golden. Remove from oven and cool. Before serving put 1/2 teaspoon of red raspberry or red currant seedless preserve in the center of each plain round, top it with one "holed" round. The red color is important for the look of the cookies and the sour flavor of raspberry or currant compliments them well. Unfilled cookies can be stored for weeks in an airtight container.

Next day: Make little balls, dip each in egg white and dredge in grated chocolate. Let the "truffles" dry for 10 minutes and place them in petit-four holders.
